column2: Demonstrates accurate understanding of MYP structure, subjects, requirements, and progression.
Demonstrates understanding of ATL, ATT, Global Contexts, IDU, Projects, Service, and Learner Profile.
Demonstrates clear understanding of MYP assessment criteria, e-Assessment, e-Portfolios, and certification.
Demonstrates ability to connect MYP requirements and assessment practices to student support.
Demonstrates accurate understanding of subject groups, HL/SL, course options, and Diploma requirements.
Demonstrates understanding of EE, TOK, CAS, Learner Profile, and other core components.
Demonstrates accurate understanding of assessment, Diploma requirements, and pathways.
Demonstrates ability to use DP knowledge to appropriately guide and support students.
Demonstrates a clear understanding of the philosophy, purpose, structure, and requirements of CAS.
Clearly distinguishes between supporting students with CAS and supervising or managing CAS.
Demonstrates how an SC can support planning, documentation, reflection, continuity, and student ownership.
Identifies common misconceptions, challenges, and potential concerns students may face during CAS.
Demonstrates meaningful reflection on how the training changed their understanding and will influence their practice as an SC.
